title: 'Ries iterates and re-iterates, evangelizes and preaches… doesn't get very practical'
summary: Sebastian Gebski — a prolific Goodreads reviewer with 1,287 reviews and 1,455 followers — publishes a substantive 2-star critique: agrees the topic is interesting but calls the diagnosis oversimplified and the last chapters unbearable. Notable as one of the few high-volume reviewer skeptical takes on the timeline.
blockquote: If you expect this one will get as much reverb as "Lean Startup" - it's not going to happen. The topic (& the promise associated -> what to do to preserve your initial success, and culture, and effectiveness - as your company grows and scales) is actually very interesting, so the potential was definitely in place, but ... the diagnosis is overly simplified.
